name: g
description: Manage Git and GitHub work from commits, evidence-backed issue classification, and read-only taxonomy proposals through delivery status, reviewed pull-request delivery, active-session audits, and consistent SemVer versioning.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Git and GitHub work from issues to reviewed pull requests.
interface.longDescription: G bundles focused Git and GitHub workflows for commits, issue lifecycle with verified attachments and exact native blocked-by dependencies, evidence-backed selection of existing issue labels and native types, explicit read-only proposals for missing repository labels and organization issue types, repository triage, investigations, Actions failures and permissions preflights, exact-head delivery-status inspection, review threads, drafted or directly published releases with curated notes and description improvements, stars, stacked pull requests, draft pull-request delivery, consistent SemVer versioning suggestions, guarded release-controller operation and authoring, and read-only active-session audits. It uses direct Git for local work, the GitHub connector for supported remote operations, and gh only for connector gaps and the explicit gh-stack wrapper.
defaultPrompt: Triage this repository's GitHub issues, pull requests, checks, releases, and delivery risks.
Investigate and fix a GitHub issue, review thread, or failing GitHub Actions check.
Commit and safely send local changes to GitHub, then verify the pull request's delivery state.
